title: LivePhantoms
body:
# 🦇 LivePhantoms
LivePhantoms is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft plugin that makes phantoms truly feel like a nightmare. Give them more health, more damage, and a brand new kidnapping mechanic that lets them swoop down and carry players into the sky!

Whether you're looking to spice up survival gameplay or give your players something new to fear at night, LivePhantoms is the perfect addition to your server

**Customize your phantoms**

## Features:
### Allow to modify:
- Phantom Spawning
- Phantom Kidnapping
- Phantom Health
- Phantom Damage

  
<details>
<summary>config.yml</summary>


```
##################################################################
 LIVE PHANTOMS PLUGIN: BY Jiraf0
 Here you can disable/enable some phantom mechanics
 Here you can modify phantom attributes
 ¡TYSM FOR USING MY PLUGIN! C;
##################################################################

config:
  phantom-spawn-enabled: true
  phantom-kidnapping: true
  phantom-health: 40
  phantom-damage: 2
```


  


</details>



### Permissions:
- livephantoms.admin (Permission to all commands)

### Commands:
- /livephantoms reload
- /livephantoms help
  
Aliase: /lips
  
💥 New Phantom AI Behavior
When enabled, phantoms can grab players and lift them into the air for a truly horrifying experience.

📦 Zero Dependencies
Works out-of-the-box on any Spigot, Paper, Purpur or **Folia** server (1.20.x - 1.21.x supported).
